correctness.rationale: Every maximal geodesic is an opposite-corner path with a single rung; this gives exactly 2n hyperedges. A necessary and sufficient two-inequality condition yields the full enumerator by a disjoint two-case subtraction. Minimal transversals are exactly 3n specified pairs and n(n-4)(n-5)/3 triples (n>=6), because every larger transversal contains one. Direct BFS-based enumeration through eight rungs agrees on all vertex subsets. The finite check is not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Provides exact counts of all geodesic-hitting sets by budget and all inclusion-minimal options for every two-row ladder, with a genuinely structural phase transition from only optimal minimal sets to cubic many non-optimal minimal triples at six rungs. These facts have practical combinatorial meaning as availability and irredundancy profiles and are not recoverable from the constant minimum gt=2 alone.
